findings.highlight: Saber is so beautiful, so I'm sure everyone must have liked her.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーはあれだけ美人なんだし、すごく人に好かれたと思う。
findings.governingReading: Because Saber is beautiful, Shirou thinks she was probably very well liked.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s likelihood judgment becomes universal certainty.

findings.highlight: Calling her Saber is what's throwing me off, but I bet she was an ordinary girl who never held a sword back in the day.
findings.evidenceJa: そもそも剣士だなんて呼ぶから勘違いしてしまうが、セイバーだって昔は、剣なんて持たない普通の子だったのではないか。
findings.governingReading: Shirou speculates that before becoming Saber she may have been an ordinary girl who did not carry a sword.
findings.explanation: An imagined ordinary girl who did not carry a sword becomes someone who never held one.

findings.highlight: I may be stern, but I do not recall being harsh to those around me."
findings.evidenceJa: 私は厳しくはありますが、周りに強要した覚えなどありません」
findings.governingReading: Saber distinguishes being strict herself from forcing that strictness on people around her.
findings.explanation: Not imposing strictness on others becomes not being harsh to them.

findings.highlight: "Yeah, but you're not usually so emotional, so that was new to me."
findings.evidenceJa: 「ああ。セイバー、あんまり自分の感情で話さないじゃないか。だから、今のは新鮮だった」
findings.governingReading: Shirou says Saber seldom speaks on the basis of her own feelings.
findings.explanation: Speaking from personal feeling becomes displaying emotion.

findings.highlight: "D-do you really think so? I was simply expressing what I believe."
findings.evidenceJa: 「そ、そうでしょうか？　私は自分の信念に基づいて行動しているつもりですが」
findings.governingReading: Saber answers that she intends her conduct to be based on her convictions.
findings.explanation: Acting from conviction becomes expressing a belief.

findings.highlight: "Of course not. What is required from me is not my own personal opinion, but rather my opinion based on my standing and position. That is true even now.
findings.evidenceJa: 「それは当然です。私に求められるものは個人としての意見ではなく、立場としての意見ですから。それは今も昔も変わらない。
findings.governingReading: Saber says the demand that she speak from her position rather than as an individual has not changed from past to present.
findings.explanation: Saber’s continuity between past and present loses the past.

findings.highlight: There is no point in my saying anything unconnected with my purpose.
findings.evidenceJa: そのため以外のことを口にするべきではないし、
findings.governingReading: Saber says she ought not speak of things unrelated to protecting Shirou.
findings.explanation: An obligation not to speak beyond her protective purpose becomes lack of utility.

findings.highlight: And there is no sense in me thinking otherwise."
findings.evidenceJa: 考える必要もないでしょう」
findings.governingReading: Saber says there is no need for her to think about matters outside that protective purpose.
findings.explanation: No need to think beyond one’s role becomes no sense thinking otherwise.

findings.highlight: "Uh, that may not be entirely true, but...well, if you say so, then I guess it's okay."
findings.evidenceJa: 「—いや、そういう事じゃないんだけど……まあ、セイバーがそういうならいいか」
findings.governingReading: Shirou says Saber has missed his point, then lets the subject drop because the mood has softened.
findings.explanation: “That is not what I mean” becomes partial disagreement with Saber’s claim.
